chunks.text: The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality. Self-attention relates positions in a sequence to compute a representation of the sequence.
The attention function maps a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output. The output is a weighted sum of values, where weights are computed from query-key compatibility.
The encoder and decoder use stacked self-attention and point-wise fully connected layers. This architecture models dependencies between sequence positions without recurrence or convolution.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

chunks.text: The key idea is to randomly mask some of the tokens from the input, and then predict those masked tokens. This objective enables deep bidirectional representations.
BERT is pre-trained using masked language modeling and next sentence prediction. The model learns contextual representations from unlabeled text.
A task-specific output layer is added to the pre-trained model and all parameters are fine-tuned on labeled examples for downstream language understanding.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

chunks.text: We combine parametric memory with a non-parametric memory, a dense vector index of Wikipedia. Retrieved documents provide explicit evidence for knowledge-intensive generation.
A neural retriever accesses documents while a sequence-to-sequence generator produces output conditioned on the query and retrieved passages.
Retrieval-augmented models can improve open-domain question answering and fact verification by grounding generation in an external document collection.
